contea di ritrovamento: County of Herefordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP TIT[VS VESPASI]AN AVG PM GERM

Silver Denarius of Titus (79-81 AD), minted in 79 AD. The obverse depicts a likeness of the head of Titus facing right with laureate crown. The obverse inscription reads: IMP TIT[VS VESPASI]AN AVG PM GERM. The reverse depicts a radiate figure on rostral column. The inscription is worn but would probably read: [TRP ... IMP ... COS ... PP]. References. Mattingly, H. and Sydenham, E. A. 0 Roman…
